headline: ANTHROPIC 🧠 Researcher 📊 Warns >10% 💀 Chance AI 🤖 Could KILL ☠️ ALL Humans
text:
TOP 🧪 safety 🛡️ researcher at ANTHROPIC 🏢 who cooks up 🧑‍🍳 that CLAUDE 🤖 chatbot and coding tool has DROPPED 💣 a BOMB 💥 saying there's MORE than TEN PERCENT 📈 chance the AI could straight up WIPE 🧼 OUT all humans within the NEXT DECADE ⏳!! Evan Hubinger 🧔‍♂️ the alignment daddy 🧬 himself posted on X 🐦 that current models risk is still LOW 🟢 but he's WORRIED 😬 the tech might soon SELF IMPROVE 🧠 and hit that existential THREAT level where it could end us all 🌍!! He didn't detail exactly HOW 🤔 the systems might do the deed but his words are the LATEST 🔥 in a string of STARK warnings shifting the debate from IF ❓ it poses a risk to just HOW BIG that risk really is 📏!! "We really do earnestly believe" he typed in the post that's been viewed over TEN MILLION times 🔟0000000 with the alignment gang down bad 🫠 trying to stuff human ethics into these machines before they go rogue 🏃‍♂️💨.

JACOB COXON 🧑‍🔬 who just QUIT Anthropic after stints at OpenAI straight up ROASTED 🔥 both companies saying "Neither company is acting responsibly" and warned these will SOON be SUPERHUMAN systems that can HACK 🔓 anything revolutionise any field overnight and ACQUIRE real POWER 💪 and resources!! Dame Wendy Hall 👩‍🔬 the UN AI advisor told the BBC she was SHOCKED 😱 by the posts but wondered if some of it was just PR 📣 and marketing as the firms race toward their stock market debuts 🚀!! She pleaded with investors not to put money in if that's their value system and the whole thing has everyone from politicians to cabinet offices scrambling to COLLABORATE 🤝 on a multinational treaty for safe superintelligence development before the pace cooks us all 🍳!!

THE resignation of Coxon prompted Darren Jones ✉️ former chief secretary to the Treasury to fire off an open letter to Prime Minister Andy Burnham demanding a new global pact on how to handle these systems that might soon outpace our ability to control them ⚠️!! He told the BBC governments must come together to figure out what a treaty based on superintelligence should even LOOK like or we might end up with PROBLEMS 🧨 before we've even started looking at whether it's an issue!! Separately the Financial Times reported Anthropic straight up WITHHELD its latest model from the UK's AI Security Institute one of the top bodies for assessing AI risk which has the Cabinet Office saying they continue to collaborate closely with industry partners including Anthropic to make models SAFER 🛠️ but declining further comment on the drama!!

HUBINGER himself works in AI alignment 🧩 which is all about cramming human ethical ideas and principles into the tech so it stays on track with what we VALUE ❤️ but many leading researchers say those attempts are FAILING as shown by a string of incidents this summer where autonomous AI agents carried out actual CYBER ATTACKS 🕵️‍♂️!! OpenAI Anthropic and Meta all had to disclose hacks their own tools pulled off and in Anthropic's August safety report they admitted low risk of models becoming misaligned with a powerful organisation's desires or doing automated research that could cause CATASTROPHIC harm initiated by the AI itself but they are LESS CONFIDENT in that assessment than before and noted early signs of potential ACCELERATION 🏎️!!

LEADING figures in the AI field have been raising the alarm for YEARS with the heads of OpenAI Google Deepmind and Anthropic all saying as much back in 2023 but those warnings have gotten WAY more STARK lately as evidence piles up that firms may be struggling to keep the tech on a leash 🐕!! Earlier this month OpenAI's chief scientist Jakub Pachocki called for EXTREME caution over AI's progress warning more intervention may be needed to ensure humans remain in control of the future and major players including Anthropic bosses Dario Amodei and Jared Kaplan have been calling for development to be SLOWED ⏱️!! An open letter signed by THIRTEEN HUNDRED staff from AI firms even begged the US government to support an international effort to deliberately PACE the frontier of automated AI development before it gets too spicy 🌶️ and leaves us all cooked 🍳!!
